metadata.name: solana
metadata.model_count_note: The supplied metadata table reports 30 models, while the Solana manifest parser output contains 264 model nodes. Both values are retained pending verification of what the 30-model figure refers to.

longest_path.note: Unweighted longest path; not duration-based critical path.

data_quality_notes: Counts and graph properties are derived from the user-provided Solana parser console output.
Generation membership is parsed from the nx.topological_generations output.
Source-like means in-degree zero in the model-only graph; dbt source resources are excluded.
Sink means out-degree zero in the model-only graph.
Non-model resources such as sources and tests are excluded.
The longest path is measured by node/edge count, not execution duration.
The generation widths are taken from the parser output; disconnected DAG components can appear at the same topological generation.
